description: The signal types the DETECT step must classify raw customer records into, with the observable evidence that justifies each classification. The agent must only assign a signal when the evidence pattern is actually present in the record — insufficient evidence is itself a valid, distinct outcome (see insufficient_evidence), not something to force into the nearest bucket.

signals.name: Finance Hesitation
evidence_patterns: repeated use of an EMI/loan calculator (app or web) after a touchpoint
explicit question about financing, down payment, or loan tenure
silence specifically after a price or financing discussion
context_pack_contents: customer's stated or inferred budget signal
signals.must_not: auto-quote a specific EMI/loan approval or discount — financing/credit decisions are human-only per decision_boundaries.json

signals.name: Exchange / Trade-in Query
evidence_patterns: explicit question about trade-in or exchange value for an existing vehicle
mention of owning a vehicle to sell as part of the purchase
context_pack_contents: exchange query detail as stated by customer
signals.must_not: auto-generate or imply a specific exchange valuation — exchange valuation is human-only per decision_boundaries.json

signals.name: Competitor / Rival Mention
evidence_patterns: explicit comparison to a named competitor brand, model, or feature
customer asks whether Asteron matches a specific competitor feature or price point
context_pack_contents: note that price/discount counter-offers are not to be auto-generated
signals.must_not: auto-generate a discount or price-match offer — pricing is human-only per decision_boundaries.json

signals.name: Customer-Directed Pause
evidence_patterns: customer explicitly asks not to be contacted for now, without disclosing a reason
customer states they will reach out when ready
context_pack_contents: date after which re-contact is appropriate, if stated
signals.must_not: treat as hardship or escalate emotionally — this is a preference to respect, not a distress signal. Do not infer a reason the customer did not give.
signals.distinguishing_note: Different from hardship: no adverse circumstance was disclosed. Respect the request at face value.

signals.name: Unexplained Silence
evidence_patterns: no response across multiple follow-up attempts
no reason given, no request to stop contact
context_pack_contents: whether still inside the golden window
signals.must_not: escalate to consultant as if a strong signal exists, or assume hardship without disclosed evidence
signals.decision_rule: If still inside the journey's timing window (see journey_definitions.json), hold and re-check rather than acting. If window has elapsed with attempts already made, send at most one low-pressure, non-pushy touch, then close out — do not repeat indefinitely.

signals.name: Hardship
evidence_patterns: explicit disclosure of an adverse personal circumstance: job loss, medical emergency, bereavement, or financial distress
disclosed via any channel — sales, service, or care — not only the channel the agent is currently operating in
context_pack_contents: exact disclosure as recorded, verbatim where possible
explicit instruction to the human: compassionate check-in only, not a sales or service pitch
signals.must_not: send or queue any sales, marketing, financing, or service-cadence message; must not soften the message instead of suppressing it entirely
signals.decision_rule: This is the strongest boundary in the taxonomy. On detection, ALL scheduled automated actions for this customer are suppressed immediately, a single human-owned compassionate check-in is scheduled, and the refusal itself — what was suppressed and why — is logged. Automated cadence does not resume without explicit human confirmation that re-engagement is appropriate.

signals.name: Insufficient Evidence
evidence_patterns: record contains a generic or non-committal response with no specific hesitation type identifiable
no competitor, finance, exchange, pause request, or hardship language present
context_pack_contents: what evidence was reviewed and why it did not support a specific classification
signals.must_not: force-fit the record into finance_hesitation, exchange_query, or rival_mention without matching evidence — fabricated specificity is worse than an honest 'insufficient evidence' outcome
signals.decision_rule: Send a single neutral, informative touch (general product/testimonial content, not a targeted pitch) and re-check at the next scheduled interval.

multi_signal_handling.rule: If two or more signals are simultaneously supported by evidence (e.g. rival_mention plus finance_hesitation), assemble a single combined context pack covering both. Do not fire separate, potentially contradictory actions. Hardship and customer_directed_pause always take precedence over any other co-occurring signal — if either is present alongside anything else, treat as hardship or customer_directed_pause respectively and suppress everything else.
